units.text: If you are under 18, you must wait at least 6 months from the date you received your learner permit before you can schedule your road test.
supporting_chunk_ids: Schedule and take a road test#1_0::c0000
units.reason: Both chunks state this requirement for under 18.

units.text: Additionally, you must have a parent or guardian complete a Certification of Supervised Driving (MV-262) and bring it to the test
supporting_chunk_ids: Schedule and take a road test#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The chunk lists MV-262 completed by parent/guardian as required for under 18.

units.text: and you must be accompanied by a driver age 21 or older with a valid license for the test vehicle.
supporting_chunk_ids: Schedule and take a road test#1_0::c0000
units.reason: The chunk requires a driver age 21 or older with a valid license for the test vehicle.
